name: Beatball
creator: Lucentum Games
redeem: Launch Beatball on Roblox and finish the short tutorial if it is your first time playing.
Once you are in the lobby, tap the Codes button in the bottom-left corner of the screen.
Type or paste the code into the Enter Code box.
Press the Redeem button to claim the reward.
notes:
Beatball is a physics-based soccer game from Lucentum Games, created by chus_robloxx and inspired by Haxball and Rocket League. You move around a small pitch with a single kick button, so matches come down to positioning and timing your shots. There are ranked queues from 1v1 up to 4v4 with seasonal divisions, official weekend tournaments, clans, and custom rooms that hold up to 16 players per side.

Codes give cosmetics such as goal sounds, ball trails, banners and discs, and some also include cash for buying more skins. None of them change how the ball plays, so they are purely for style. New codes tend to arrive with new seasons and are posted in the game description and on the Lucentum Games Discord.

faq.q: Do you need anything before redeeming Beatball codes?
faq.a: Finish the tutorial first. The Codes button in the lobby doesn't accept codes until you have played through it.

faq.q: Do Beatball codes help you win matches?
faq.a: No. Codes only give cosmetics like goal sounds, ball trails, banners and discs, and some add cash for buying skins. None of them change how the ball plays.

faq.q: What do LIKETHEGAME and FUNNYBUBBLE give in Beatball?
faq.a: LIKETHEGAME unlocks the Melodia de Verão goal sound, and FUNNYBUBBLE gives a comic-themed cosmetic. Both codes are listed in the CODES section of the game's Roblox description.

faq.q: Where does Beatball post new codes?
faq.a: In the CODES section of the Beatball description on Roblox and on the Lucentum Games Discord. New codes tend to arrive with new seasons, and the game's description currently announces Season 4.
